split.why_not_inherited: Every dialogue quotes a corpus TRAIN sentence, so inheriting the parent's split would put all 80 in train and leave no dev. Inheritance is enforced as a CONSTRAINT instead - tests/test_experiment_assets.py fails any row deriving from a corpus dev or test utterance - and the train/dev split is assigned at dialogue level from a recorded seed.
split.why_overridden: build_manifest re-derives splits from a hash of the group id. Left alone it would have given V-real and V-tts different splits from the same scripts, and the paired comparison would have stopped being paired.

derivation.why: build_manifest copies one dataset-wide derivation onto every row, but each dialogue quotes a different corpus sentence and the leakage assertion reads derivation PER ROW. One shared value would have made that check vacuous.

registry.gate_behaviour: The manifests were written before the registry entries existed, and the suite failed with 'v-real-v1 has no registry entry' - the rule in CLAUDE.md enforced by the glob added in 1a97bca, on exactly the datasets it was widened for.

condition_2_precursor: Tokenisation accounting is condition 2 and is produced at step 14.
